GTSR's enhancements don't stop at its own doorstep: GTNL's steam machines can share them too. Thanks to @Pseudo and runtime detection, it makes no difference whether GTNL is installed; flip gtnlEnhancement in the config and GTNL steam machines gain the same treatment — superheated steam at four times the burn for four times the speed, cooling hatches welcome.

It is off by default — and while it is off, everything stays perfectly quiet.

§8§oGood things kept secret? One config toggle away.§r
